text: Proposed, refining D-0221 after #355's second review: what escapes the bound implementation is checked for every call into it during a test, from setUp to its cleanups, from any caller in any thread, though only the test's own calls count as exercise. Python's sys.monitoring sees a Python call's exception unwind wherever it runs, and the profiler, set in every thread, sees a C call from Python code raise, with the RAISE that follows saying what. A C function that other C code calls, as map(d.pop, keys) does, stays invisible, what it raises included. Each declared exception class its tests' modules have loaded is pinned before any test runs, so no test can swap what an Exsures names; one no loaded module holds by then is pinned at its first escape.
